name: Sparky: Electrical Study
subtitle: Exams, guides and site tools
promotionalText: Build your electrical knowledge with practice questions, answer explanations, study guides and practical site tools. Keep learning offline and track your progress.
description:
Sparky brings electrical revision and practical tools together in a native app for iPhone and iPad.

PRACTISE AND REVIEW
Work through 12 electrical subjects, with practice tests, answer explanations and saved progress. Topics include the 18th Edition, Building Regulations, PAT testing, inspection and testing, electrical installation, ECS health and safety, AM2 and special locations.

LEARN AT YOUR PACE
Explore learning guides, tutorials and searchable reference notes. Save useful notes and work through guided inspection-training activities.

TOOLS FOR THE TASK
Use site calculators and keep useful calculation history alongside your study materials.

STUDY OFFLINE
Access bundled study content and keep progress on your device. You can study without an account. Sign in with an existing Sparky account to synchronise exam progress with the web app.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Use native navigation, adjustable text, light and dark appearances, and configurable navigation and exam categories.

Sparky is an independent study and calculation aid. It is not an official examination provider, qualification, or substitute for the current regulations and competent professional judgement.
reviewNotes: Core study content, calculators and local progress work without signing in. Dismiss the profile sheet to continue without an account. Optional email/password sign-in synchronises exam progress and a private profile with electrics.pages.dev. There are no in-app purchases, ads, social feeds, or public user-generated content. Settings contains direct Privacy policy, Help and support, and Delete account links. Account deletion requires the account email, password and explicit confirmation on the linked secure page. Practice questions are owned by the developer. This is an independent educational app, not an official awarding-body app.
